sql:
WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, account_id, gross_cents
  FROM orders_dv_agg_00
  WHERE status = 'paid'
    AND currency = 'EUR'
    AND gross_cents <> 0
),
posted_refunds AS (
  SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM refunds_dv_agg_00 r
  JOIN qualifying_orders qo ON qo.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY r.order_id
),
order_refund_totals AS (
  SELECT qo.order_id, qo.account_id, qo.gross_cents, COALESCE(pr.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents
  FROM qualifying_orders qo
  LEFT JOIN posted_refunds pr ON pr.order_id = qo.order_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COUNT(ort.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       SUM(ort.gross_cents) AS gross_cents,
       SUM(ort.refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
       SUM(ort.gross_cents) - SUM(ort.refund_cents) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN SUM(ort.gross_cents) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(SUM(ort.refund_cents) * 100.0 / SUM(ort.gross_cents), 6) END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM accounts_dv_agg_00 a
JOIN order_refund_totals ort ON ort.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.region = 'east'
GROUP BY a.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id;

sql:
WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, o.gross_cents
  FROM orders_dv_agg_01 o
  WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'settled')
    AND o.currency = 'USD'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM refunds_dv_agg_01 r
      WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
        AND r.refund_status = 'posted'
    )
),
order_refunds AS (
  SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM refunds_dv_agg_01 r
  WHERE r.refund_status = 'posted'
    AND r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM qualifying_orders)
  GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COUNT(qo.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund_cents), 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund_cents), 0) AS REAL) * 100.0 / CAST(SUM(qo.gross_cents) AS REAL), 6)
       END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM accounts_dv_agg_01 a
INNER JOIN qualifying_orders qo ON qo.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN order_refunds rf ON rf.order_id = qo.order_id
WHERE a.region = 'west'
GROUP BY a.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM status_events_dv_latest_00 s
  WHERE s.event_time < '2025-01-13 12:00:00'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    e.entity_id,
    s.status,
    s.event_time,
    s.seq,
    s.event_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY e.entity_id
      ORDER BY s.event_time DESC, s.seq ASC, s.event_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM entities_dv_latest_00 e
  LEFT JOIN eligible s ON s.entity_id = e.entity_id
)
SELECT entity_id, status, event_time, seq
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY entity_id

WITH first_view AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(event_time) AS view_at
  FROM funnel_events_dv_funnel_00
  WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= '2025-01-11 00:00:00' AND event_time < '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY person_id
), first_cart AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, MIN(e.event_time) AS cart_at
  FROM funnel_events_dv_funnel_00 e JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'add_to_cart' AND e.event_time >= v.view_at
  GROUP BY e.person_id
), first_purchase AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, MIN(e.event_time) AS purchase_at
  FROM funnel_events_dv_funnel_00 e JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.event_time >= v.view_at
  GROUP BY e.person_id
)
SELECT p.person_id, v.view_at, c.cart_at, x.purchase_at,
       CASE WHEN v.person_id IS NOT NULL AND x.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS converted
FROM people_dv_funnel_00 p
LEFT JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = p.person_id
LEFT JOIN first_cart c ON c.person_id = p.person_id
LEFT JOIN first_purchase x ON x.person_id = p.person_id
ORDER BY p.person_id

  GROUP BY person_id

  FROM funnel_events_dv_funnel_01 e
  JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase'
    AND e.channel = 'web'
    AND e.event_time >= v.view_at
    AND e.event_time <= '2025-01-14 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY e.person_id
)
SELECT p.person_id, v.view_at, c.cart_at, x.purchase_at,

FROM people_dv_funnel_01 p
